# alphamind-dashboard Copilot Instructions

Follow AGENTS.md and repository-specific architecture/docs.

Use the governing principle:
DETERMINISTIC FIRST → BOT FIRST → AI ONLY WHEN MATERIAL → AUTHORITY/RISK GATE → HUMAN APPROVAL FOR CONSEQUENTIAL ACTIONS.

Implement only bounded issue acceptance criteria. Reuse existing canonical systems instead of creating duplicates. Add appropriate tests. Never bypass CI, permissions, approval gates, or release controls. Do not merge or deploy your own work.

When assumptions are necessary, choose the safest reasonable implementation and document the assumption in the PR.
